test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Three articles are bought at Rs. 180 each. One of them is sold at a loss of 10%, If the other two articles are sold so as to gain 20% on the whole transaction, then what is the gain percentage on the two articles?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of three articles = Rs. 180 each

One article sold at loss = 10%

Two articles sold at gain = 20%

**Formula used:**

Gain% = Gain/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Cost of three articles = Rs. (180 × 3)

⇒ Rs. 540

Total gain percentage on whole transaction = 20%

Then,

SP of all three articles = (540 × 120/100)

⇒ 648

SP of first article = (180 – 180 × 10%)

⇒ (180 –18)

⇒ 162

CP of other two article = 360

SP of other two article = (648 – 162)

⇒ 486

Gain on two article = (486 – 360)

⇒ 126

Gain% = (126/360 × 100)

⇒ 35%

**∴ The gain percentage on two articles is 35%**
